The Living Canvas of India

Made by Jai Aaditya

Select a highlighted state to open the artefacts it is known for, from rock-cut temples and bronzes to painted scrolls.

Five states are featured. Each is coloured with a pigment from its own art traditions.

Across time

All twenty artefacts in order, from the oldest to the traditions still practised today. Select one to open it.

Made by Jai Aaditya for 21LEM301T Indian Art Form, SRM Institute of Science and Technology.

Sources

Information is drawn from museum, heritage and government records. Dates for ancient works are approximate.

  • Archaeological Survey of India
  • Indian Museum, Kolkata
  • Government Museum, Chennai
  • British Library, London (Mewar Ramayana)
  • Victoria and Albert Museum, London (Kalighat paintings)
  • Geographical Indications Registry of India
  • Press Information Bureau, Government of India
  • Photographs collected by the group from publicly available online sources
